description: One row per cited upstream tool; every tool the generated README toolchain table lists has a row. 'cite' holds the tool's own requested reference(s), each a full reference: 'authors', 'title', 'journal', 'volume', 'year' and first page ('pages') or a 'publisher', with its 'arxiv', 'doi', 'ascl' or 'url' identifiers; 'id' is the identifier the tool's request names. A requested reference whose title names an agent system other than the tool is given without its title. 'basis' records where the reference comes from: 'request' (the tool asks to be cited this way), 'listed-reference' (the tool's own page or README names its reference paper), 'release-paper' (the tool's own pages were unreachable or name no reference, and the release paper was confirmed at its arXiv abstract page) or 'home-page' (no reference found; cite the home page). 'also' holds references the tool asks for in a stated case. Bibliographic fields were taken from INSPIRE-HEP, the DOI registry and the ASCL on 2026-10-14. 'withheld' rows keep identifier strings until their tool ships. scripts/maintenance/render_citations.py renders README Appendix B from this file.
